name: Hammer strike
effect: Heavily strikes an enemy with a hammer when appeared to battle. The enemy loses 20% max HP if it has a shield.

name: Easter bless
effect: Receive bless from the spirit of easter when appeared to battle.Heal pet's 150% HP in 15 turns.

name: Thousand Bird
effect: Use lightning power to pierce the enemy when appearing to battle. 25% chance to paralysis enemy for 1-2 turns. Ignore the shield.

name: Psycho Conquer
effect: Show out the great psycho power to shock the enemy when appeared to battle. Decrease the enemy's attack into 50%.

name: Sneak Attack
effect: Stab monster sneaky with its fork when appeared to battle. Breaks the enemy shield immediately.

name: Sealing Sight
effect: Seal part of enemy's power with its eye when appeared to battle. Seal the last skill the enemy used for 5 turns.

name: Gravity Zone
effect: Create a zone that reverse the battlefield. For the next 5 turns, monsters with lower speed move first.

name: Pegasus Punch
effect: Quickily attacks the enemy when appeared to battle. Deals 3 damage to a shield.

name: Heat wave
effect: Emits a heat wave when appeared to battle. Penetrates even the toughest enemy. Enemies lose 10% HP after hit.

name: Entangle
effect: Constrict the enemy with the tentacle to limit the enemy's movement when appeared to battle. Decreases enemy's attack and speed by 10%.

name: Ancient Protect
effect: Call to the ancient spirit to protect itself when appeared to battle. Create a shield that blocks 1 attack.Each block increases defense by 10%.
